title: Morocco and AI: Who Is Accountable When the Model Enters Government?
hook_text: Morocco just appointed Ahmed Rahhou to lead AI.
script:
Morocco appointed Ahmed Rahhou to lead AI at the ministerial level.
Zoher Bijou analyzed this new government shift for Atalayar.
Decrees 2.23.404 and 2.23.405 set the stage for digital transition back in June 2023.
State agencies now face tough questions over who bears legal blame when automated workflows fail.
Public officials must decide who is responsible if administrative models make mistakes.
Can institutional accountability survive when algorithms handle sensitive citizen data across state agencies?
